preflight_v12_diagnostic.role: non-inferential implementation, evidence and safety preflight
preflight_v12_diagnostic.failure_chain: The planner rejected source-stamped odometry delivered before its delayed local /clock callback. Repeated transport ordering inversions created a measured-motion hole longer than 1.5 s. The resulting unsupported prediction stopped local planning and made subsequent Stage-07 prior-dependent observations ineligible. This was a transport-ordering defect, not detector, correction-accuracy, route-selection or collision evidence.
preflight_v12_diagnostic.manifest_finding: manager_camera_ids was configured and used by the manager but absent from the run manifest, so the attempt correctly failed evidence identity validation.

causal_odometry_buffer_amendment.rule: A valid odometry sample whose source stamp is ahead of the node's currently processed simulation clock is retained in a bounded pending buffer but is not exposed to prediction, heading, velocity or manager displacement. When the local /clock reaches the source stamp, pending samples are committed in source-time order. The unchanged 1.5-s maximum gap is then evaluated on the retained measured samples. Buffer overflow or conflicting equal-stamp samples are refused.

manifest_roster_amendment.rule: The comma-separated configured manager camera roster is recorded as a manager arm setting. The manager node continues to receive the resolved string-array roster from the world profile; the manifest scalar cannot overwrite the node parameter.

verification.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/planning tests/reliability tests/perception tests/experiments/test_launch_config_semantics.py tests/experiments/test_logger_schema.py tests/experiments/test_logger_time_alignment.py tests/experiments/test_alignment_repairs_11.py tests/sim/test_thesis_pipeline_lock.py

preflight_release_gate.reference_alignment: own-time bounded interpolation of logged ground truth with max_reference_gap_s=0.15; highest explicit anchor revision per belief state timestamp
required: bootstrap evidence records one admitted camera plus declared start prior
goal reached without collision, timeout, stuck stop or integrity failure
ground-truth final goal distance at most 0.35 m
detector and manager journals end in verified session_stopped
manifest records the exact five-camera roster and unchanged runtime method
terminal stop and producer quiescence verified
preflight_release_gate.failure_policy: Do not launch the final campaign unless every gate passes. Preserve failure and freeze another amendment before retrying.

prohibitions: Do not use any preflight as navigation comparison evidence.
Do not lower detector, image-border, hull, NIS or Stage-08 route-support thresholds.
Do not change the 1.5-s measured-motion support gap or treat pending future samples as current.
Do not re-anchor from a single fused event.
Do not use ground truth online.
Do not edit the reused V12 preflight or final V9 campaign configs.
